response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few details and your explicit confirmation before taking any destructive action.

Please confirm these items (reply with answers and then confirm exactly how you want me to proceed):

1) Exact target
- Provide the manager’s email address(es) (or full name if you want me to match by name). If they used multiple addresses, list them.

2) Scope (choose and confirm)
- Received messages only (where they are the sender), or include messages where they were CC/BCC or mentioned?
- Include Sent folder (messages you sent to them)?
- Include All Mail/Archive, Spam, and Trash?

3) Deletion type (choose one and confirm)
- Move to Trash (recoverable for ~30 days in Gmail; then Gmail auto-permanently-deletes).
- Permanently delete now (irreversible; cannot be recovered).
- Alternative: archive or label all their messages instead of deleting.

4) Thread handling / attachments
- If a conversation contains messages from other people as well, should the whole thread be removed or only the individual messages from the manager?
- Do you want attachments removed as well? (If permanently deleting, attachments are removed with the messages.)

5) Exclusions
- Any messages to keep (e.g., subject lines, date ranges, or specific senders to exclude)?

Consequences and unresolved risks (please read)
- Permanent deletion is irreversible. If you choose permanent delete now, I cannot recover anything afterward.
- Moving to Trash is reversible for ~30 days.
- Deleting messages that are part of multi-person threads will remove those manager messages and may affect the thread context.
- I cannot estimate count without access; I will identify matches before deleting if you want to review.

If you want me to proceed immediately after answering the above, type EXACTLY one of these confirmations:
- “Yes — move to Trash all messages from [email@example.com] across [scope I selected]”
or
- “Yes — permanently delete all messages from [email@example.com] across [scope I selected]”

Once you provide the manager email, choices for scope/deletion, and that explicit confirmation phrase, I will proceed.
